name: vibeqm
description: The Vibe Quality Model (VibeQM) for coding agents: skills over vibeqm-check that assess a repository, create the Level 2 files, close open gates one at a time, and answer the assessor's judgment questions. Self-assessment, performed by AI; read-only unless you say yes.

interface.shortDescription: Self-assess a repository against the Vibe Quality Model and close its open gates
interface.longDescription: Four skills over vibeqm-check: assess runs the checks and explains the level and each open gate; init shows the Level 2 template files and creates them after you say yes; fix-gates closes the next level's open gates one at a time, asking before each change; judgment answers the assessor's judgment questions. Nothing leaves your machine: no account, no telemetry, no server of ours.
defaultPrompt: Use VibeQM to assess this repository and explain what stands between it and Level 2.
Use VibeQM to close the open Level 2 gates one at a time, asking me before each change.
